request: This request belongs to a longitudinal nutrition project, but the current export contains only one selected visit from each participant. We deliberately selected complete cases so that every participant appears once in each assay and no visit-level averaging is necessary. The statistician has signed off on the continuous measurements and the identifier reconciliation. Please keep the interpretation at the level of conditional association across the selected subjects. The output is intended for a colleague who prefers a long table to a square matrix and will do the plotting independently after the computation has finished. Run DRAGON on serum_metabolites.tsv and serum_proteins.tsv. Both contain finite continuous sample-by-feature data from the same 30 people with unique identifiers. Use lambda1=0.2, lambda2=0.6 and edge_list output to serum_graph.tsv.
